title: Proces-verbal privind centralizarea voturilor și atribuirea mandatelor la alegerile pentru membrii din România în Parlamentul European din data de 09 iunie 2024

pages.hint: This is not a county table. The rows are the lines a, a1, a2, b, b1, b2, b3, c, d, e, and f of a Romanian election return. Use only the line's letter code (for example a1 or b3) as each row's label, and read the figure in the right-hand column; there is no total row.

This is not a county table. The rows are the 16 lists and independent candidates, numbered 1 to 16 in the Nr. crt. column. Use only that number as each row's label, and read the figure in the right-hand column (Numărul voturilor valabil exprimate obținute); there is no total row.

This is not a county table. The rows are the lists and independent candidates numbered 1 to 6 in the Nr. crt. column, then a Total row. Use only that number as each row's label (and Total for the last row), and read the figure in the right-hand column (Număr mandate atribuite).
